review.tagline: Desktop agent that researches and edits your local documents with cited answers
review.summary: SurfSense is a desktop app, a NotebookLM-style agent that indexes your files on local disk and answers with citations. It can also create and edit PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, always writing a new copy, and generate podcasts, mind maps, flashcards and quizzes. It works with any OpenAI-compatible API or a local model and needs no account.
review.audience: Users who need AI document research and editing without uploading files
strengths: Index stays on local disk; no account needed
Edits PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint as new copies, originals untouched
Works with any OpenAI-compatible API or a local model
Installers for Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and Linux (AppImage, deb)
weaknesses: Hosted web app is being sunset; export workspaces before 18 October 2026
Word and PowerPoint to PDF needs LibreOffice, enabled in Settings
Image generation needs an image model; none is chosen by default
OCR covers only Latin, Chinese and Japanese script
needs: Needs LibreOffice (optional, for Office to PDF)
